item.title: The Green Veil - Chapter 22 The Voice That Returns
item.description:
After twenty-two chapters and forty-five years since the transmission first came to Earth, the circle closes on the exact morning it began.
Christmas Day 2025, 45 years to the hour after the lights descended over Rendlesham Forest in 1980, the same signal returns.
Not from above.
From within.
One voice, neither male nor female, neither ancient nor new, speaks inside every human mind at once:
“Remember who you were… before you forgot.”
No translation is needed.
A child in São Paulo hears it in Portuguese.
An elder in Nunavut hears it in Inuktitut.
A soldier in Donetsk and a monk in Lhasa hear the identical silence that contains their own first language.
At Capel Green, where the bent trees still remember 1980, Leo Barrett stands in the frost as the forest exhales the breath it has held for forty-five years.
Jack, Sgt. B, and DeCarp watch the sky refuse to open, because it never closed.

item.title: U.S. Transhumanist Party Virtual Enlightenment Salon - TransVision Madrid 2025 Summit
item.description:
On Sunday, December 21, 2025, at 1 p.m. U.S. Pacific Time, watch the fifth stream from the TransVision Madrid 2025 International Longevity Summit, which took place on October 1-2 in Madrid, Spain. The U.S. Transhumanist Party has allied with TransVision Madrid and Alianza Futurista, its fellow transhumanist political party in Spain, to bring you six more presentations by distinguished scientists, doctors, and longevity advocates.
The presentations included in this compilation stream include the following:
- Dr. Eduardo Díaz-Rubio, President of the Royal National Academy of Medicine of Spain, specialist in internal medicine and oncology, presented his outlooks on immortality, health extension, and the prospects for advancing longevity through medical institutions.
- Dr. Francisco Mera Cordero of Blue Healthcare, a specialist on aging and COVID, presented on the situation in regard to longevity in Spain
- George Church, PhD, Professor, Harvard & MIT, presented on recent advancements in anti-aging protein, gene, cell, and organ therapies, providing a thorough overview of numerous research projects in progress.
- Andrea Maier, MD, Founding President of the Healthy Longevity Medicine Society, a physician, scientist, and longevity doctor, discussed the applications of precision geromedicine in clinical practice.
- Kenneth Scott (VivaSparkle), discussed his personal approaches to life extension as an 83-year-old entrepreneur, investor, and recipient of numerous emerging longevity treatments.
- Dylan V. Livingston, Founder and CEO of the Alliance for Longevity Initiatives (A4LI) discussed the economic imperatives of reversing aging and achieving a Longevity Dividend, as well as recent efforts to shape pro-longevity policies in the United States, such as the Montana Right to Try Act.
The U.S. Transhumanist Party thanks TransVision Madrid and its fellow transhumanist political party in Spain, Alianza Futurista, for providing the means to offer these presentations to our audience.
Visit the website of TransVision Madrid: https://www.transvisionmadrid.com/
Visit the website of Alianza Futurista: https://www.alianzafuturista.com/
Watch the U.S. Transhumanist Party previous streams of TransVision Madrid events and presentations:

Stream 2: Angel Versetti, the Panel on Longevity Advocacy, and Liz Parrish: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6xG7qCU511g

Stream 4: Maria Blasco, João Pedro de Magalhães, José Crespo-Barrios, Daniel Muñoz-Espín, Natalie Coles, Lars Hartenstein: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=51obk3-7Ob8

item.title: Into The Fire - Natalie Cash
item.description:
This Friday, December 19, 2025 at 7:00 pm CST Live, on Episode #78 of Into the Fire, it is my absolute pleasure to bring on a friend of mine who I have loved listening to for the past several years. Its Natalie Cash, who as a news outlet recently said was a staple on the radio since 2011. Natalie, is a Country Music Association Award winner and a two time nominee from the Academy of Country Music.
Natalie was heard on the radio waves for many years to include working for stations in Dallas, Las Vegas and Tulsa.
Not only is she a blast to hang out with who is full of energy, she also is the Founder of Bikes for Kids here in Tulsa, that she continues to promote east year during the Christmas season in an attempt to get bike donations, which has received hundreds of bicycles for needy children in the Tulsa community...
Most importantly, she is the mother of two awesome boys, and is definitely a huge personality here in Tulsa.
I could not think of a better person to have join us going into the Christmas break.... She will be a lot of fun to have on.....

item.title: Briefing with the Chief - Traffic Fatalities Again
item.description:
Recently Cal Matters, an online publication that serves to improve California Government through transparency, published an article regarding the high and increasing fatalities on California roads over the last 10 years.  We have previously addressed traffic fatalities on Briefing with the Chief and applaud Cal Matters for finally addressing part of the issue.  Some Legislators in Sacramento are calling for action but have been ignored by their legislative colleagues.    
What is not addressed in this issue is to correlation between the increase in traffic fatalities and the “defund the police movement”.  Many on the left have implied racist intent to traffic enforcement.  Legislatures and political leaders around the country have deemphasized utilizing police for traffic enforcement with tragic consequences.  
On today’s show I will comment on these failures and address the need to refund and refocus police to enforce traffic laws, to save lives.

item.title: Alien Spirit with Sev - Chris Jordan
item.description:
Chris Jordan is the founder of Curious Research, an organization whose mission is to help unite the research of traditional science with fringe sciences such as UFOlogy, Cryptozoology, and Parapsychology
Chris has written the Field Observation & Encounter Log made specifically for paranormal, cryptic and UFO field researchers to standardize their field data.
I know Chris through his show Curious Realm, where he has been kind to interview me a few times. He and his guests discuss topics related to science, technology, history, and culture. Chris also takes his show on the road, broadcasting live from conferences around the country talking with the guest speakers and attendees.
Plus, Chris is a musical composer. His newest is Experiencer: Music for Targeted Minds Vol 2 which is designed to help relieve PTSD of Contactees and others who have had supernatural/paranormal experiences. He incorporates binaural beats and pure tone therapy, creating music for meditation and inter-dimensional travel.
As a live audio/video engineer for over 20 years, Chris owns Curious Events providing audio and video production to conferences, symposiums, and various types of gatherings.
He just returned from the International Remote Viewing Association Conference. Chris is a remote viewer, and he spoke at the Psi Games in VA this past August.
We get into a variety of topics, including Remote Viewing: how you can do it and why you would want to.
https://curiousresearch.org/
https://curiousrealm.com/
sev@planetsev.com
